description: This Java source file defines the CommunicationEventServices class, which provides services for handling communication events within the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include sending communication events as emails or FTP transfers, processing incoming emails, creating communication events from various triggers, updating events' statuses, and managing attachments. The class interacts extensively with OFBiz's entity engine, service dispatcher, and email/messaging components, indicating its role in managing communication workflows, including email processing, outgoing notifications, and integrations with external systems.

classes.name: CommunicationEventServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods for managing communication events such as emails, FTP transfers, and inbound email processing within the OFBiz framework. Implements functionalities including sending emails, handling FTP content, processing incoming emails to generate communication events, updating event statuses, and creating communication events from external triggers.

methods.name: sendCommEventAsEmail
methods.description: Sends a communication event as an email, constructing the email with content, attachments, and recipients based on the communication event record.

methods.name: sendCommEventAsFtp
methods.description: Processes a communication event designated for FTP transfer by sending associated content via FTP and updating event statuses accordingly.

methods.name: sendEmailToContactList
methods.description: Sends emails to a list of contacts specified in a contact list entity, managing individual contact status and handling validation errors.

methods.name: setCommEventComplete
methods.description: Marks a communication event as complete by updating its status and timestamps.

methods.name: createCommEventFromFtpTransfer
methods.description: Creates a communication event record for an outgoing FTP transfer initiated externally, including content association.

methods.name: createCommEventFromEmail
methods.description: Records a new communication event triggered by an outgoing email, capturing email details and associating content.

methods.name: updateCommEventAfterEmail
methods.description: Updates a communication event record after an email has been sent, including subject, message ID, timestamps, and attachments.

methods.name: storeIncomingEmail
methods.description: Main handler for incoming email messages, parsing message headers and content, identifying sender/recipient parties, and creating inbound communication event entities, including handling multipart and recursive parts.

methods.name: markCommunicationAsRead
methods.description: Event which marks a communication event as read, updates the role status, and returns a 1px image to the browser/mail client.
